title: Kenya discharges its last Ebola patient, a milestone toward virus-free status
detail: BBC reports that Kenya has discharged its last Ebola patient, a milestone toward being declared virus-free. Kenya recorded an imported case announced 6 October.

media.caption: Kenya discharges its last Ebola patient

title: DRC Ebola cases pass 11,000 with at least 5,387 deaths
detail: Government data released 10 November put confirmed DRC cases at 11,042 and deaths at 5,387 across eight of 26 provinces. It is the second-largest and second-deadliest Ebola outbreak on record, behind West Africa 2014-16.

media.caption: Health worker checks a visitor's temperature at an Ebola treatment centre in Beni, North Kivu
